What we do

From a ferry ticket to a journey across the world

Travelgram Agency is a travel agency in the centre of Athens. We organise day trips and multi-day tours, journeys abroad, private transfers, and issue flight and ferry tickets — with the care we would want for our own trips.

Our signature journey

Armenia, with people who know it by heart

Medieval rock-cut churches, pagan temples, mountains, river gorges and lakes. Food, wine and brandy, and the warm welcome of the locals. And Yerevan, the “pink city”, with its sunlit charm and its ancient, proud history.

Who we are

“Travel, like love, is an attempt to turn a dream into reality.”

Travelgram Agency was founded to offer innovative, high-quality services in the management, development and promotion of travel packages, and tourism services designed around the needs of each traveller.

We work with the most recognised airlines and ferry companies, with hotels and accommodation in Greece and worldwide, and with travel and transport providers — so your trip gets the detail it deserves.

Questions

Good to know

Anything else? Call us — we are happy to help.

210 496 8953
Where is your office?

At 4 P. Tsaldari St, Athens (104 31), next to Omonia Square — a few steps from Omonia metro station.

What are your opening hours?

Monday to Friday 09:00–20:00, Saturday 10:00–18:00 and Sunday 10:00–16:00.

How do I book a trip?

Call us on +30 210 496 8953, send an e-mail or drop by the office. We tell you the available dates, what the price includes, and book your place.

Are the prices on the website final?

Day-trip prices are per person, as we quote them today. Multi-day prices are indicative, from last season — for the new dates we confirm the exact price before you book.

Do you arrange airport transfers?

Yes. We arrange private transfers to and from the airport, the ports, hotels and other destinations.

Do you issue flight and ferry tickets?

Yes. We work with airlines and ferry companies, and with hotels in Greece and abroad.

Do you organise trips to Armenia?

Yes — it is one of our favourite journeys: a 7-day trip by air, “Treasures of Armenia”, and the 9-day “Diamonds of Armenia”.

Are you a licensed agency?

Yes. Our tourism licence (MHTE) number is 0206Ε60000367500 and our business registry (GEMI) number is 169953009000.
